Title: Numeric field accepts raw alphabetic characters during fast typing
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Open Plate Girder Bridge project. 2. Focus on Web Depth input. 3. Rapidly paste 'ABC123DEPTH'. 4. Press Enter or click Run Design.
Expected_Behavior: Input should immediately reject non-numeric characters or display inline validation badge before execution.
Actual_Behavior: Raw string was permitted in UI field until full validation pass triggered error on solver run.

Title: Zero web thickness causes unhandled ZeroDivisionError in slenderness calculation
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Create bridge project. 2. Set web thickness = 0.0 mm. 3. Click validate.
Expected_Behavior: Validation engine should reject non-positive thickness with ERR_NEGATIVE_OR_ZERO_INPUT.
Actual_Behavior: Calculation crashed with ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero in slenderness ratio d/tw.

Title: Corrupted JSON project file causes blank canvas instead of explicit error alert
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Corrupt project JSON by omitting closing bracket. 2. Click File -> Open. 3. Select file.
Expected_Behavior: Application should display modal alert 'Corrupted project file: invalid JSON syntax'.
Actual_Behavior: Application stayed on blank canvas with traceback written only to stderr.

Title: PDF report export fails silently when output path contains special Unicode symbols
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Design valid bridge. 2. Export report to folder path containing Hindi/Unicode characters 'C:\Bridge\डिजाइन\report.pdf'.
Expected_Behavior: Report file should be generated and saved to specified destination.
Actual_Behavior: Export dialog closed but no file was written; no error message shown to user.

Title: Tooltip missing on cross-girder spacing field
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Hover cursor over 'Cross Girder Spacing' input label. 2. Wait 2 seconds.
Expected_Behavior: Informative tooltip displaying 'Recommended spacing: 2.5m - 5.0m per IRC:24' should appear.

Title: Impact factor capping not strictly enforced for extreme spans (> 45m)
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Set span to 48.0m. 2. Calculate impact factor 4.5 / (6.0 + span). 3. Compare with IRC:6 minimum of 0.10.
Expected_Behavior: Impact factor must be clamped to minimum 0.10 for steel highway bridges.
Actual_Behavior: Unclamped formula yielded 0.083 without applying lower threshold.
